name: Original Poison of Illness: confirm equipped axe application and save

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 1280
resolution y = 720
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = false

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local Actor=types.Actor
local I=require('openmw.interfaces')
local frames=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frames=frames+1;if frames%15~=0 then return end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died observing original poison application')
 local inv=Actor.inventory(self)
 print('TutorialPoison stock='..inv:countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x8dc73))..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' paused='..tostring(core.isWorldPaused())..' mode='..tostring(I.UI.getMode()))
 for _,o in ipairs(inv:getAll()) do if o.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x8dc73) then local v=types.Potion.record(o);assert(v.name=='Poison of Illness' and v.value==37 and v.weight==.5,'Original poison properties changed') end end
 for _,o in pairs(Actor.getEquipment(self)) do if o.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x90613) then print('TutorialPoison Rusty Axe equipped') end end
end}}}}
